(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DST_DX_Case_Manager_Details_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CareBridge_Get_CareAdvance_CaseDetails' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Case_Manager_Details475_') AS OLE_DST_DX_Case_Manager_Details_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DST_DX_Case_Manager_Details_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'CareBridge_Get_CareAdvance_CaseDetails' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Load_Case_Manager_Details475_') AS OLE_DST_DX_Case_Manager_Details_TableName,

/************************************************************************************************************************** 			Get Case Manager Crosswalk  **************************************************************************************************************************/  INSERT INTO ##TXCB_CASEMANAGERLKP 	SELECT DISTINCT DRMD.ROLE_MASK_ID ROLE_MASK_ID ,DRMD.ROLE_MASK_DESC ROLE_MASK_DESC  	FROM 		[CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_ROLE_MASK_DEFINITION] DRMD WITH(NOLOCK)   	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_ROLE_MASK] DRM WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON DRMD.ROLE_MASK_ID = DRM.ROLE_MASK_ID 	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_ROLE] DR  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON DRM.ROLE_ID = DR.ROLE_ID 	WHERE DR.ROLE_ID = 1   /************************************************************************************************************************** 			Get Case Manager Details for Eligible Members **************************************************************************************************************************/ insert INTO ##CASE_MANAGER_Details SELECT    		 CARE_FIRST_NAME 		,CARE_LAST_NAME  		,CARE_EMAIL 		,CARE_PHONE 		,CARE_MEME_CK 		,CARE_CASE_ID 		,CARE_GROUP_CK 		,CASE_KEY 		,[USER_ID] 		,UPDATE_DATE 		,UPDATE_TIME 		,RNK_LATEST_CASE_ID FROM ( 	SELECT DISTINCT 		 DU.FIRST_NAME  AS CARE_FIRST_NAME 		,DU.LAST_NAME   AS CARE_LAST_NAME 		,DU.EMAIL		AS CARE_EMAIL 		,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(DU.PHONE_1,'-',''),'.',''),')',''),'(',''),' ','') 						AS CARE_PHONE 		,DC.MEME_CK		AS CARE_MEME_CK 		,DC.CASE_ID		AS CARE_CASE_ID 		,DC.GROUP_CK	AS CARE_GROUP_CK 		,FC.CASE_KEY 		,FC.[USER_ID] 		,UPDATE_DATE 		,UPDATE_TIME 		,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY DC.MEME_CK ORDER BY UPDATE_DATE DESC, UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS RNK_LATEST_CASE_ID  	FROM	[CAREADVANCE_DM].APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC  WITH(NOLOCK)  	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_CASE] DC  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON FC.[CASE_KEY] = DC.[CASE_KEY] 		AND FC.[GROUP_CK] = DC.GROUP_CK                                    	AND FC.GROUP_CK in (4,13,54,3,31) 	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].[APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS] DCS  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON DCS.STATUS_ID = DC.STATUS_ID 		AND	DCS.STATUS_ID in ('1','2','4','5','9','11','16','17') 	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER DM  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON DM.[MEME_CK] = DC.MEME_CK 		AND DM.[GROUP_CK] = DC.GROUP_CK 	INNER JOIN [CAREADVANCE_DM].APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_USER DU  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON DU.USER_ID=FC.USER_ID 	INNER JOIN ##TXCB_CASEMANAGERLKP RMD  WITH(NOLOCK)  		ON RMD.[ROLE_MASK_ID] = DU.[ROLE_MASK_ID] 	INNER JOIN ##TXCB_MEMBER_ELIGIBILITY MEM  		ON MEM.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK  		AND MEM.GRGR_CK = DM.GROUP_CK )CASE_MANAGER WHERE RNK_LATEST_CASE_ID = 1  select * from ##CASE_MANAGER_Details
